results.title: Understanding Group B Strep PCR: Rapid Diagnosis for Safer Births
results.content: ## What Is Group B Strep PCR and Why Should We Care? While high-income countries have integrated group B strep PCR testing with relative ease, many developing regions still wrestle with infrastructure, costs, and access — leaving a gap in preventive care where it’s needed most. In simple terms, *group B strep PCR* is a molecular diagnostic technique used to detect the DNA of Group B Streptococcus bacteria in patient samples quickly and with high accuracy. Future Trends in Group B Strep PCR Testing. * **Q:** *How fast can group B strep PCR deliver results compared to culture testing?*. * **Q:** *Is group B strep PCR testing expensive for small clinics?*. **Mini takeaway:** Group B strep PCR testing combines speed, accuracy, and impact, placing it at the heart of modern maternal and neonatal care globally — especially as affordable and portable solutions emerge. results.title: Targeted screening for the detection of group B Streptococcus ...
results.content: ## International Journal of Infectious Diseases. International Journal of Infectious Diseases. # Targeted screening for the detection of group B *Streptococcus* during the intrapartum period by real-time polymerase chain reaction. PCR detected far more intrapartum group B *Streptococcus* cases than culture. To compare the intrapartum group B *Streptococcus* (GBS) detection rate and turnaround time in pregnant women using a polymerase chain reaction (PCR) assay versus a culture method, while also comparing GBS detection rates between a risk-based antibiotic-indicated group and the other high-risk group. Paired vaginal-rectal swabs from 174 participants were evaluated by both real-time PCR and standard culture. No significant difference was found in detection rates between the risk-based antibiotic-indicated group and the other high-risk group (27.3% vs 18.5%, *P* = 0.19). Real-time PCR assay provides a higher and more rapid detection of GBS compared to culture methods. ### Clinical trial registration. Thai Clinical Trials Registry (TCTR20210801003).
